verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's Conditional Access docs confirm network/trusted-location and device compliance signals drive access revocation, plus MFA policies per app via SSO, which covers network/device/location context. However, evidence lacks detail on risk-based signals (e.g., impossible travel, anomaly detection) and granular per-group policy configuration beyond high-level marketing claims. Missing for 10: risk-signal scoring detail, per-group policy examples, independent/hands-on validation of conditional access behavior.
